# Hand-curated names for AfterShock Pool SX (default.xbe).
# "<address> <name> [signature | data | data:<type>]"; later lines override
# earlier ones and the generated files (xdklib.txt, xdk.txt, consts.txt).
# Names are reconstructed: the binary has no symbols beyond the XDK libraries.

# ---- CCamera (0x104 bytes; one instance, g_Game.camera) -----------------------

00011320 CCamera::FreeLook void __thiscall CCamera::FreeLook(CCamera *this)
